body.prompt: A Korean man in his fifties sitting alone on a sofa in a dim living room at night, looking at his phone with a flat, slightly disappointed expression, the phone screen glow on his face, no readable screen. Same painterly cinematic oil-painting texture and fine film grain, but a cool desaturated blue-grey palette with only one small warm light, horizontal 16:9 widescreen film frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no readable screens, no watermark, no brands anywhere.
